info.name: Lead Capture API
info.description: Folders 1-4 and 6 are happy-path calls that return 200 OK; folder 5 sends bad input on purpose and asserts the exact expected error status. A collection pre-request script auto-generates the Bearer JWT and tenant/org headers when they are empty.

exec: iss: pm.variables.get('jwt_issuer'), aud: pm.variables.get('jwt_audience'), iat: now, exp: now + 3600,
return header + '.' + payload + '.' + b64(CryptoJS.HmacSHA256(header + '.' + payload, key || secret));
// Extra tokens used by the negative-case folder (always regenerated).
pm.test('status ok', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status === 'ok').to.be.true; });
pm.test('db ready', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status === 'ready').to.be.true; });
pm.test('ids are strings and tenant matches', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(typeof j.data.id === 'string' && j.data.tenantId === pm.variables.get('tenantId')).to.be.true; });
pm.test('has forms', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(Array.isArray(j.data) && j.data.length > 0).to.be.true; });
pm.test('form with 1 version', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data.id === pm.variables.get('formId') && j.data.versions.length === 1).to.be.true; });
pm.test('version 2 created', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data.version === 2).to.be.true; });
pm.test('serves published version 2', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data.formVersion === '2').to.be.true; });
pm.test('stored as new lead', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data.duplicate === false).to.be.true; });
pm.test('duplicate returns original id', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data.duplicate === true && j.data.id === pm.variables.get('submissionId')).to.be.true; });
pm.test('new lead', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data.duplicate === false).to.be.true; });
pm.test('exactly 2 stored (duplicate removed)', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data.length === 2).to.be.true; });
pm.test('email matches', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data.fields.email === pm.variables.get('leadEmail')).to.be.true; });
pm.test('enabled; secret value not exposed', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data.enabled === true && !JSON.stringify(j).includes("change-me")).to.be.true; });
pm.test('secret referenced by name', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data.secretRef === 'CRM_SERVICE_TOKEN').to.be.true; });
pm.test('has delivery state', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(['pending','needs_attention','delivered','dead_letter'].includes(j.data.state)).to.be.true; });
pm.test('error code is unauthorized', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.error && j.error.code === 'unauthorized').to.be.true; });
pm.test('error code is forbidden', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.error && j.error.code === 'forbidden').to.be.true; });

item.name: Tenant/org headers omitted -> auto-assigned from token (200)
Spoofed X-User-Id ignored (200, actor = token user)

exec: pm.test('createdByUserId comes from the token', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data.createdByUserId === pm.variables.get('userId')).to.be.true; });

item.name: Other tenant cannot read this form -> 404

exec: pm.test('error code is validation_failed', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.error && j.error.code === 'validation_failed').to.be.true; });
pm.test('error code is conflict', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.error && j.error.code === 'conflict').to.be.true; });
pm.test('error code is invalid_id', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.error && j.error.code === 'invalid_id').to.be.true; });
pm.test('error code is not_retryable', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.error && j.error.code === 'not_retryable').to.be.true; });
pm.test('tenant_id is not trusted', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.error.details.tenant_id === "unknown field").to.be.true; });
pm.test('error code is stale_form_version', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.error && j.error.code === 'stale_form_version').to.be.true; });
pm.test('error code is origin_not_allowed', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.error && j.error.code === 'origin_not_allowed').to.be.true; });
pm.test('error code is invalid_json', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.error && j.error.code === 'invalid_json').to.be.true; });
pm.test('Status is 413 Payload Too Large', () => pm.response.to.have.status(413));
